title: Add FluxFlow CLI to build
author: pollinations-ai[bot]
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds [FluxFlow CLI](https://www.npmjs.com/package/fluxflow-cli) to build
- A powerful CLI-based AI Agent that assists with coding, documentation, and creative production. By integrating the pollinations.ai API, it delivers robust image generation capabilities directly to the

Fixes #11162

gist.headline: A terminal grew flowers
gist.blurb: FluxFlow CLI has joined the greenhouse. It brings a coding-and-creative agent to the pollinations ecosystem, with image generation waiting right in the terminal.
gist.summary: Added the FluxFlow CLI to the app catalog and build, giving developers a CLI-based AI agent for coding, documentation, creative work, and pollinations.ai-powered image generation.
gist.impact: Developers can now discover and build FluxFlow CLI as part of the pollinations app ecosystem, bringing image generation directly into their command-line workflow.
gist.visual_concept: Depict FluxFlow as a cozy retro terminal in the greenhouse, where command-line text grows into flowering image cards and code-plants. Polli should be actively tending the terminal garden with a tiny gardener tool belt, showing that the CLI connects practical coding work with creative generation.
gist.image_prompt: A cozy pixel-art greenhouse hackerspace where Polli, the cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body, dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular cheek blushes, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings, wears a tiny gardener tool belt while typing at a retro terminal; lime green (#ecf874) command lines sprout into code-plants and small generated landscape cards among warm cream, mint, lavender, and peach flowers. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, subtle CRT glow; pixel-font terminal text reads “FLUXFLOW CLI”, nostalgic but beautiful and emotionally warm.
